snippets.snippet_text: "This year, over 50% of my income will be from my direct stores, so friends, that's just not true. You do have to market your direct store, and you need to learn how to market like an e-commerce business owner, which is different than how you market on Amazon, Kobo and others. But if I can do it, you can too!"
"I tried shopify and felt like I needed a PhD. I couldn't figure it out. I like the ease of Payhip, plus I don't need 67 plugins to do simple things."

intake_notes: Substack blog post (December 17, 2025). Seller reports over 50% of income from direct stores; prefers Payhip over Shopify for simplicity.
